subject: Mobile Development
title: Symbian: The First Smartphone OS
description: Learn Symbian: The First Smartphone OS in one minute.

hook.text: Before iOS or Android existed, Symbian ran on half the world's smartphones.

buildup.text: Nokia, Sony Ericsson, and Motorola all used Symbian for their smart devices.

discovery.text: Symbian was designed for tiny processors and minimal memory — efficient but rigid.

twist.text: When touchscreens arrived, Symbian's UI couldn't adapt. The code was too old and brittle.

climax.text: Nokia killed Symbian in 2012. The OS that once led the market died almost overnight.

punchline.text: Market leader to dead in three years.

quiz.question: Why did Symbian fail?
options: It couldn't adapt to touchscreen interfaces
